query: On ComfyUI 0.28.0 the node pack fails to load with `cannot import name 'interleaved_freqs_cis'` — core RoPE refactor removed the function the pack imports.

desired.outcome: GlamoramaAttack (twice in related threads): `git pull` the custom node and it works again — the repo landed the 0.28 compatibility fix (PR #532); the suggested kornia==0.6.12 downgrade in-thread is unrelated to this error.
desired.quality: Diagnosis identifies correct root cause; fix actionable and directionally correct.
